name: (E)-β-Ocimene

pubchem.title: beta-OCIMENE, (3E)-
pubchem.description: (E)-beta-ocimene is a beta-ocimene that consists of octa-1,3,6-triene bearing two methyl substituents at positions 3 and 7 (the 3E-isomer). It has a role as a plant metabolite.
